name: Leafless Wisteria
source:
The player takes on the role of an artist betrayed by her best friend and robbed of her passion project.
Determined to start anew, she draws a new comic inspired by her strange dreams, naming the protagonist "Murasaki You" - a name that constantly echoes in her sleep. However, the moment she writes that name down, she is suddenly pulled into a mysterious world called "The Sea".
Amidst a world fraught with danger, she must trace fragmented clues from her dreams to reveal her true identity and past, facing manipulators, secret-keepers, and the silhouettes that appear every night.
In the end, is she just a wanderer lost in dreams... or the very reason behind this never-ending nightmare?
